name: Pilatus PC-6 Porter
summary: Swiss STOL utility turboprop with a long nose, a high wing on a strut and a taildragger layout, used for skydiving, bush flying and survey work.

wings: High wing with a single strut on each side
Large flaps along the trailing edge
engines: Single PT6A turboprop in a long, tapering nose with exhaust stubs
fuselage: Slab-sided, boxy cabin behind a very long nose
Tailwheel (taildragger) gear with long main legs
Large windows and big side doors

tellTales: Long pointed turboprop nose on a boxy high-wing taildragger
Single strut per side on a high wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The Beaver has a short, round radial-engine nose and a two-blade prop; the Porter has a long, tapering turboprop nose.
The Otter is larger and has a round radial nose; the Porter has a long turbine nose.
The Caravan has tricycle gear; the Porter is a tailwheel aircraft.
